title: Trader Diary: 82.5k BTC Rally
content:
🚀 8:00 am: Spot buy the dip, “this time I’m holding forever.”
🕒 12:00 pm: Leverage 10x on futures, “just a safety net.”
🕛 3:00 am: BTC dips 0.3%, heart rate hits 180, “I’m fine, I have a stop‑loss…maybe.”
lesson: Never trust a “just a safety net” when the net is made of paper.
question: Who’s still staring at the 1‑minute chart at 3 am? Drop your coffee count 👇
